description: Calculate projected daily and billing cycle Compute Units (CU) and USD costs for planned call volumes across one or more methods, factoring in method weights and free credit allowances from /v1/plans. Available without an API key. Estimates the API key count for planned traffic under the free-account `key_defaults` (free new-key default CU/s); the result also echoes `paid_key_minimums` (the paid-account floor, not a cap: the first paid top-up raises each key to at least this value and higher custom limits are kept, and a key's actual limits come from the console Keys list). Cost and quota assumptions are for free-tier accounts. Use this tool for volume budget calculations and capacity planning. For looking up raw system pricing tables, use get_pricing instead. For checking whether a single method is supported on a specific chain, use get_method_info instead. Accepts 'lines' array of {method, calls_per_day} or single 'method' and 'calls_per_day'.

calls_per_day.description: Expected daily call volume (non-negative integer). Single-method mode.

lines.description: List of methods and daily call volumes to estimate.
